whenToUse: First run screens and card sections that add the first record, invite a team or connect a data source
Search with no matches, a not found page with a search field, or a prompt shown before the first search
Caught up notices with nothing left to act on, such as inbox zero or no new notifications

whenNotToUse.when: A complete first run page with finished copy, artwork and actions, ready to drop in
A screen shown while a fetch is still running and no result is known yet
A square container for one glyph in a list row, feature card or settings item

agentNotes: Adding `border` to `Empty` draws a dashed outline, since every style sets a dashed border style on it; add border-solid for a solid line
`EmptyMedia` with `variant` icon puts the glyph in a small muted tile; the default variant has no fill, so drawings go there
`Empty` takes `flex-1` and centers its children, so in a flex column with a set height it fills the free space
